passages.text: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
passages.sermon:
Amraphel was king of Shinar.
Arioch was king of Ellasar.
Chedorlaomer was king of Elam.
Tidal was king of Goiim.
These four kings joined together.
They went to war.
They fought against Bera, king of Sodom.
They fought against Birsha, king of Gomorrah.
They fought against Shinab, king of Admah.
They fought against Shemeber, king of Zeboiim.
They fought against the king of Bela.
Bela is also called Zoar.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵי֙ אַמְרָפֶ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ שִׁנְעָ֔ר אַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר כְּדָרְלָעֹ֙מֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֔ם וְתִדְעָ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃ עָשׂ֣וּ מִלְחָמָ֗ה אֶת־ בֶּ֙רַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֔ם וְאֶת־ בִּרְשַׁ֖ע מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֑ה שִׁנְאָ֣ב׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַדְמָ֗ה וְשֶׁמְאֵ֙בֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ צְבֹיִים וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִיא־ צֹֽעַר׃

passages.text: The latter five came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea ).
passages.sermon:
Five kings joined together.
These kings were Bera, Birsha, Shinab, Shemeber, and the king of Bela.
They became allies.
They gathered in the Valley of Siddim.
The Valley of Siddim is also called the Salt Sea.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ חָֽבְר֔וּ אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּ֑ים ה֖וּא יָ֥ם הַמֶּֽלַח׃

passages.text: For twelve years they had been subject to Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
passages.sermon:
Five kings ruled over Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela (Zoar).
These five kings served Chedorlaomer, king of Elam.
They served him for twelve years.
In the thirteenth year, the five kings rebelled against Chedorlaomer.
passages.original: שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עָבְד֖וּ אֶת־ כְּדָרְלָעֹ֑מֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה מָרָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim, and the Horites in the area of Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is near the desert.
passages.sermon:
Chedorlaomer was a king.
He had allied kings with him.
In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and his allies went out to fight.
They defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim.
They defeated the Zuzites in Ham.
They defeated the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim.
They defeated the Horites in the area of Mount Seir.
They continued as far as El-paran.
El-paran is near the desert.
passages.original: וּבְאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה בָּ֣א כְדָרְלָעֹ֗מֶר וְהַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַיַּכּ֤וּ אֶת־ רְפָאִים֙ בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת קַרְנַ֔יִם וְאֶת־ הַזּוּזִ֖ים בְּהָ֑ם וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֵימִ֔ים בְּשָׁוֵ֖ה קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃ וְאֶת־ הַחֹרִ֖י בְּהַרְרָ֣ם שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֚ד אֵ֣יל פָּארָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
passages.sermon:
Chedorlaomer was a king.
He had allied kings with him.
They turned back from their previous battles.
They came to En-mishpat.
En-mishpat is also called Kadesh.
They attacked the territory of the Amalekites.
They defeated all the land of the Amalekites.
They also attacked the Amorites.
The Amorites lived in Hazazon-tamar.
They defeated the Amorites in Hazazon-tamar.
passages.original: וַ֠יָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ עֵ֤ין מִשְׁפָּט֙ הִ֣וא קָדֵ֔שׁ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ שְׂדֵ֖ה הָעֲמָלֵקִ֑י וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַֽצְצֹ֥ן תָּמָֽר׃

passages.text: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the Valley of Siddim against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
passages.sermon:
Five kings ruled over five cities.
The king of Sodom led them.
The king of Gomorrah joined him.
The king of Admah joined them.
The king of Zeboiim joined them.
The king of Bela also joined them.
Bela is also called Zoar.
These five kings marched out together.
They prepared for battle.
They gathered in the Valley of Siddim.
They faced four other kings.
Chedorlaomer was king of Elam.
Tidal was king of Goiim.
Amraphel was king of Shinar.
Arioch was king of Ellasar.
These four kings stood against the five kings.
Four kings fought against five kings in the Valley of Siddim.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֜ם וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֗ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ אַדְמָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ צְבֹיִים וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִוא־ צֹ֑עַר וַיַּֽעַרְכ֤וּ אִתָּם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּֽים׃ אֵ֣ת כְּדָרְלָעֹ֜מֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֗ם וְתִדְעָל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְאַמְרָפֶל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁנְעָ֔ר וְאַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֥ה מְלָכִ֖ים אֶת־ הַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, but the survivors fled to the hill country.
passages.sermon:
The Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits.
The kings of Sodom and Gomorrah tried to escape.
Some men fell into the tar pits.
The other survivors ran away to the hill country.
passages.original: וְעֵ֣מֶק הַשִׂדִּ֗ים בֶּֽאֱרֹ֤ת בֶּאֱרֹת֙ חֵמָ֔ר וַיָּנֻ֛סוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה וַיִּפְּלוּ־ שָׁ֑מָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים הֶ֥רָה נָּֽסוּ׃

passages.text: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.
passages.sermon:
Four kings fought against five kings in the Valley of Siddim.
The four kings won the battle.
The four kings took everything from Sodom and Gomorrah.
They took all the goods from these cities.
They took all the food from these cities.
The four kings left with everything they took.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּקְחוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ רְכֻ֨שׁ סְדֹ֧ם וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אָכְלָ֖ם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since Lot was living in Sodom.
passages.sermon:
Four kings attacked Sodom.
They took Lot.
Lot was Abram’s nephew.
They took Lot’s possessions.
Lot lived in Sodom.
The kings left with Lot and his possessions.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֨וּ אֶת־ ל֧וֹט וְאֶת־ רְכֻשׁ֛וֹ בֶּן־ אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָ֖ם וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב בִּסְדֹֽם׃

passages.text: Then an escapee came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshcol and Aner, all of whom were bound by treaty to Abram.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a Hebrew.
Abram lived near the Oaks of Mamre.
Mamre was an Amorite.
Mamre was the brother of Eshcol and Aner.
Eshcol and Aner were also brothers.
Mamre, Eshcol, and Aner had a treaty with Abram.
An escapee came.
The escapee reported this to Abram.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיַּגֵּ֖ד לְאַבְרָ֣ם הָעִבְרִ֑י וְהוּא֩ שֹׁכֵ֨ן בְּאֵֽלֹנֵ֜י מַמְרֵ֣א הָאֱמֹרִ֗י אֲחִ֤י אֶשְׁכֹּל֙ וַאֲחִ֣י עָנֵ֔ר וְהֵ֖ם בַּעֲלֵ֥י בְרִית־ אַבְרָֽם׃

passages.text: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a Hebrew man.
Abram lived near the Oaks of Mamre.
Mamre was an Amorite.
Mamre was a brother of Eshcol and Aner.
Mamre, Eshcol, and Aner had a treaty with Abram.
Abram heard that his relative Lot had been captured.
Abram acted quickly.
Abram gathered his trained men.
These men were born in Abram’s household.
There were 318 men.
Abram led these men.
They pursued the captors.
They chased them as far as Dan.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָ֔ם כִּ֥י נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אָחִ֑יו וַיָּ֨רֶק אֶת־ חֲנִיכָ֜יו יְלִידֵ֣י בֵית֗וֹ שְׁמֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וַיִּרְדֹּ֖ף עַד־ דָּֽן׃

passages.text: During the night, Abram divided his forces and routed Chedorlaomer’s army, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a Hebrew man.
Abram had servants.
Abram acted at night.
Abram divided his men into groups.
Abram and his servants attacked Chedorlaomer’s army.
Abram defeated Chedorlaomer’s army.
Abram chased the enemy.
Abram pursued them as far as Hobah.
Hobah is north of Damascus.
passages.original: וַיֵּחָלֵ֨ק עֲלֵיהֶ֧ם׀ לַ֛יְלָה ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וַיַּכֵּ֑ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵם֙ עַד־ חוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְּׂמֹ֖אל לְדַמָּֽשֶׂק׃

passages.text: He retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a faithful servant of God.
Abram rescued everything that had been taken.
He brought back all the goods.
He also brought back Lot, his relative.
Abram returned Lot’s possessions.
He brought back the women.
He brought back the rest of the people.
passages.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׁב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרְכֻ֑שׁ וְגַם֩ אֶת־ ל֨וֹט אָחִ֤יו וּרְכֻשׁוֹ֙ הֵשִׁ֔יב וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
passages.sermon:
Abram defeated Chedorlaomer.
Abram defeated the kings who were with Chedorlaomer.
Abram returned after this victory.
The king of Sodom went out to meet Abram.
They met in the Valley of Shaveh.
The Valley of Shaveh is also called the King’s Valley.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹם֮ לִקְרָאתוֹ֒ אַחֲרֵ֣י שׁוּב֗וֹ מֵֽהַכּוֹת֙ אֶת־ כְּדָר־ לָעֹ֔מֶר וְאֶת־ הַמְּלָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ אֶל־ עֵ֣מֶק שָׁוֵ֔ה ה֖וּא עֵ֥מֶק הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High — and he blessed Abram and said: “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth, and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
passages.sermon:
Melchizedek was king of Salem.
Melchizedek was also a priest of God Most High.
Melchizedek brought out bread and wine.
Melchizedek blessed Abram.
Melchizedek said, “Blessed be Abram by God Most High.
God Most High is the Creator of heaven and earth.
Blessed be God Most High.
God Most High has delivered your enemies into your hand.”
Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
passages.original: וּמַלְכִּי־ צֶ֙דֶק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שָׁלֵ֔ם הוֹצִ֖יא לֶ֣חֶם וָיָ֑יִן וְה֥וּא כֹהֵ֖ן לְאֵ֥ל עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּר֤וּךְ אַבְרָם֙ לְאֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ וּבָרוּךְ֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ מִגֵּ֥ן צָרֶ֖יךָ בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֥וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִכֹּֽל׃

passages.text: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.”
passages.sermon: The king of Sodom spoke to Abram.\r\nHe said, “Give me the people.”\r\nHe said, “Take the goods for yourself.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֖ם אֶל־ אַבְרָ֑ם תֶּן־ לִ֣י הַנֶּ֔פֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻ֖שׁ קַֽח־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth, that I will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
passages.sermon:
Abram spoke to the king of Sodom.
Abram said, “I have lifted my hand in an oath to the LORD.
The LORD is God Most High.
God Most High is the Creator of heaven and earth.
I will not take anything that belongs to you.
I will not take even a thread from you.
I will not take even a sandal strap from you.
I will not accept anything that is yours.
I do this so you cannot say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָ֖ם אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֑ם הֲרִימֹ֨תִי יָדִ֤י אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ אִם־ מִחוּט֙ וְעַ֣ד שְׂרֽוֹךְ־ נַ֔עַל וְאִם־ אֶקַּ֖ח מִכָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֣א תֹאמַ֔ר אֲנִ֖י הֶעֱשַׁ֥רְתִּי אֶת־ אַבְרָֽם׃

passages.text: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.”
passages.sermon:
Abram was a faithful servant of God.
Abram spoke to the king of Sodom.
Abram said he would not take anything that belonged to the king of Sodom.
Abram made one exception.
Abram said he would accept only what his men had already eaten.
Abram also said the men who went with him could take their share.
These men were Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre.
Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre may take their portion.
passages.original: בִּלְעָדַ֗י רַ֚ק אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽכְל֣וּ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְחֵ֙לֶק֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלְכ֖וּ אִתִּ֑י עָנֵר֙ אֶשְׁכֹּ֣ל וּמַמְרֵ֔א הֵ֖ם יִקְח֥וּ חֶלְקָֽם׃ס
